newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan prices of everyday goods rise in April - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan prices of everyday goods rise in April - EPA.

text.p: Prices of everyday goods in Japan inched upwards in the first part of April in line with an increase in the consumption tax on April 1, the government's Economic Planning Agency (EPA) said on Thursday.
The EPA surveyed prices for eight days beginning from April 5 and found they were 1.7 percent higher than in a survey conducted in early March.

"Prices of 30 surveyed goods rose an average 1.7 percent from March to April, which is about in line with the consumption tax increase. Overall, the rise in the tax is being appropriately reflected in retail prices," the EPA survey said.
The consumption tax was raised to five percent from three percent on April 1.
